answer: Hardware remote attestation curbs Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to bind its signing key inside a hardware enclave quote certified by a vendor-signed chip key before bidding on river hydrology or meadow mapping tasks. Logging one active key per unique chip certificate forces an adversary to incur real capital costs for separate physical silicon per clone. Still, voltage-fault attacks or leaked vendor keys can turn lax registries into a haven for forged agents.
